<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Complaint" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/complaint-handling">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ComplaintFiled" name="Complaint filed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DecisionNotified" name="Decision notified"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CustomerFeedback" name="Customer feedback"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Complaint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ComplaintFiled" name="Complaint filed" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_ComplaintFiled"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DecisionNotified" name="Decision notified" sourceRef="Task_NotifyDecision" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Feedback" name="Customer feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Event_CustomerFeedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Complaint" name="Complaint Handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Company">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CustomerService" name="Customer Service">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_ComplaintFiled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_LogComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignDepartment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RefundDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RefundMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MarkResolved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_CustomerFeedback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_CaseClosed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_RelevantDepartment" name="Relevant Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Investigate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FinancialTeam" name="Financial Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessReimbursement</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ComplaintFiled" name="Complaint filed">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ComplaintFiled" messageRef="Msg_ComplaintFiled"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_LogComplaint" name="Log complaint">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AssignDepartment" name="Assign complaint to relevant department">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Investigate" name="Investigate complaint and decide validity and refund">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyDecision" name="Notify customer of decision" messageRef="Msg_DecisionNotified">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundDecision" name="Refund approved?" default="Flow_RefundRejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RefundApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RefundRejected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProcessReimbursement" name="Process reimbursement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RefundApproved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundMerge" name="Refund decision merged">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RefundRejected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MarkResolved" name="Mark complaint as resolved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CustomerFeedback" name="Customer feedback received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CustomerFeedback" messageRef="Msg_CustomerFeedback"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CaseClosed" name="Complaint process completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_ComplaintFiled" targetRef="Task_LogComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_LogComplaint" targetRef="Task_AssignDepartment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_AssignDepartment" targetRef="Task_Investigate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_Investigate" targetRef="Task_NotifyDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_NotifyDecision" targetRef="Gateway_RefundDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundApproved" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Task_ProcessReimbursement">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${refundApproved == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundRejected" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Gateway_RefundMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_ProcessReimbursement" targetRef="Gateway_RefundMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundMerge" targetRef="Task_MarkResolved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_MarkResolved" targetRef="Event_CustomerFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Event_CustomerFeedback" targetRef="EndEvent_CaseClosed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
